name: eclipse-switch
title: EclipseSwitch
description: control: Light/dark theme switch: the moon slides across the sun until only the corona remains (canvas 2D, server-safe switch, reduced motion -> still)

item.name: eclipse-switch
item.summary: control: Light/dark theme switch: the moon slides across the sun until only the corona remains (canvas 2D, server-safe switch, reduced motion -> still)

useWhen: The light/dark theme toggle of a site or app, as a feature in a settings card or a hero
A day/night or on/off choice with a sky metaphor
avoidWhen: A compact header toggle (it is a 250 px panel)
Pages that already show a lot of motion near it

alternatives.name: flame-switch
alternatives.when: When the toggle is not about light and dark

tiers.0: One still frame on the canvas (reduced motion, Save-Data, no WebGL2), redrawn only when the value changes
tiers.2: Animated at DPR <= 1.5 with half the particles
tiers.3: Animated at DPR <= 2 with the full particle count

reducedMotion.description: The sky jumps straight to day or totality: one frame per change, no sliding moon.

input.keyboard: A native <button role=switch>: Space and Enter toggle

a11y.notes: A native <button role="switch"> with aria-checked; its visible label is its name. The status (Day / Totality) is aria-live=polite. Before the canvas mounts a CSS sun shows the state. The sky canvas is aria-hidden.

props.name: checked
props.effect: Controlled state: true is the eclipse (dark).

props.name: label
props.effect: Visible label and accessible name of the switch.

props.name: statusText
props.effect: Visible, announced status; null hides it.

props.name: palette
props.effect: Colours of the effect (DESIGN.md A8). custom reads --fb-heat-0..4 from the page.

props.name: paused
props.effect: Universal pause prop: the effect stops drawing; the control keeps working.

props.name: maxTier
props.effect: Hard ceiling on the capability tier.

props.name: nonce
props.effect: CSP nonce for the component's <style> element.

props.name: style
props.effect: Inline styles on the root, merged after the palette variables.

mistakes: It switches its own sky only: apply your theme in onCheckedChange.
Give it a full card (at least 250 px tall); it is not a header icon.
Keep the label short; it sits on the sky.
verify: Server HTML has a switch with aria-checked and a CSS sun.
Space toggles; the status reads Totality or Day.
The moon slides in about 4 s, then nothing runs.
